column1: # Bridge overrides (owner decisions 2026-10-20, ../bridges/DECISIONS.md and PLAN.md). Override mapping.tsv for these CS1 segments only.
#   select  regex on the CS1 net prefab of those segments ("." = all of them): which part is the bridge deck
#   prefab  CS2 bridge prefab (UNVERIFIED names until the next game run; the runner's dry run reports unknown ones)
#   plan    fixed:<span,...> (exact spans, fixedIndex per edge) | count:<n> (n equal straight edges per chain) | span:<max m> (fewest equal edges ≤ max)
#           ;merge = BR001 carriageway merge onto one two-way centreline; ;fixedfile = written to import-bridges-fixed.json; ;nopillars = noPillars on the deck
#           (BR001: on the connectors and on its remaining over-water deck courses in import-all.json; PLAN.md item 4)
#   seg     m_SegmentLength (m) for the 0.6–1.4 × seg rule (BXP: ../bridges/cs2-bridge-rules.json; vanilla: bridge-rules-live.json from tools/fetch-bridge-rules.mjs)
#   Decks lower than 8 m above the terrain (bridge.lowElevation) are lifted to 8.5 m when that is ≤ 5 m and the approaches allow it, else the CS1 chain keeps its base prefab
#   (the gravel trestles BR045, BR049, BR050, BR053 at 0–3 m: a covered bridge over a ditch is wrong anyway).
#   alt     kept alternative (prefab | plan), not used; swap it into prefab/plan to try it
